title: Migrate blackfreedomstudies.org from Craft CMS
description: Full migration of blackfreedomstudies.org away from Craft CMS. Phases: 1) Audit existing site content and structure, 2) Select target stack, 3) Content modeling and frontend build, 4) Content migration, 5) QA and launch.

title: Audit existing Craft CMS site content and structure
description: Catalog all content types, entries, assets, templates, and URL structure on blackfreedomstudies.org. Document sections, fields, relationships, and any custom plugins or modules in use.

title: Select target platform and tech stack
description: Evaluate and choose the replacement platform for Craft CMS (e.g., static site generator, headless CMS, or other). Consider hosting, maintainability, cost, and editorial workflow needs.
notes: DECISION: Astro (static site generator) + Decap CMS (git-based visual editor) + Netlify or Cloudflare Pages hosting. Rationale: site is read-heavy with infrequent updates, relational content maps to Astro content collections, Decap gives editors a visual admin panel without needing a database or server. Zero hosting cost, zero maintenance.
close_reason: Selected Astro + Decap CMS on Netlify/Cloudflare Pages. Static site, git-backed CMS, zero-database architecture.

title: Design content model for new platform
description: Map existing Craft CMS content types and fields to the new platform's content model. Define schemas, relationships, and taxonomies.
close_reason: Content model designed: 5 Astro collections (events, speakers, resources, news, pages) with denormalized seasons, single resources collection with discriminator, URL structure preserving existing patterns.

title: Export content from Craft CMS
description: Extract all content entries, assets (images, documents), and metadata from the Craft CMS database. Produce portable data files (JSON/CSV) and download all media assets.

title: Build frontend for new site
description: Develop the new site frontend, matching or improving upon the existing blackfreedomstudies.org design. Implement responsive layouts, navigation, and all page templates.

title: Import content into new platform
description: Migrate exported content and assets into the new platform. Verify data integrity, fix broken references, and ensure all media is properly linked.

title: Set up URL redirects and SEO preservation
description: Map old Craft CMS URLs to new site URLs. Configure 301 redirects to preserve SEO. Verify meta tags, sitemap, and structured data carry over.

title: Configure hosting and DNS
description: Set up production hosting for the new site. Configure DNS records to point blackfreedomstudies.org to the new host. Set up SSL/TLS certificates.

title: QA testing and launch
description: End-to-end testing of the migrated site: verify all pages render, links work, assets load, forms function. Cross-browser and mobile testing. Final launch cutover.
